title: C2: Contact-frame velocity rules versus direct joint generation
hypothesis: A validated contact-frame decoder lets cold-generated velocity rules express useful pen-relative control more effectively than direct joint targets under matched rollout search.

prediction.against: baseline: direct_joint fresh final-incumbent native sustained success under the same eight-block protocol
prediction.rationale: Primary is fresh final-incumbent native sustained success, contact_rules minus direct_joint, after the matched 24-candidate search per arm, as eight paired block-level differences (pool seeds 4730-4737). A five-percentage-point gain is the minimum useful effect. Searched-winner fresh success, the final-window hit fraction and the zero-shot contrasts are secondary and cannot substitute for the primary.

protocol.command: gpu run 'nohup bash -lc "source .venv-metaworld/bin/activate && python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study contact_rules" > logs/r094_run.log 2>&1 &'
code_changes: lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/contact_rules.py (new): the study and the two actors. Both arms' generated policies read the same 182-d observation (the 157-d layout plus trusted per-fingertip contact features: distance to the pen surface, axial coordinate, relative velocity in local [normal, circumferential, axial] coordinates). direct_joint emits 20 joint targets executed as clamp(mean, -1, 1); contact_rules emits 15 normalised local-velocity requests that the frozen decoder qualified by R-096 (D-067, frozen_sha256 7219ec6d5075b4457a6642cb0199de17fdd9bea423a95b0eb17d20d885ede250; pen-following, wrist held, request scale 0.05 m/s) turns into the 20 joint targets. The child re-verifies the hash; generated code never touches the simulator; offline query_actions is refused for the contact actor.

scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: register contact_rules; it refuses to run unless the config names the frozen block, its hash and logs/pen_spin/r096_contact_settled_gate_80/summary.json with verdict pass and the same hashes. Eight independent blocks (pool seeds 4730-4737, one frozen 80-case Stage-3 manifest each, config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_contact_rules_s<seed>.yaml; screen 0-9, promotion 10-39, probe 40-49, fresh 50-79), four generation slots per arm with at most one linked correction, the same 24-candidate probe search per arm (rollout_search.independent_candidates, block seed). Both arms are monolithic and cold-generated; the orchestrator runs under .venv-metaworld and Isaac only in backend child processes.

Prompts are identical except the output-contract paragraph (and the output width the templates print, 20 vs 15): direct_joint keeps the Stage-3 joint-target paragraph verbatim; contact_rules states the request contract, the frame convention, the decoder's scales and that a zero request moves a fingertip with the pen surface. No controller, strategy or finger role is given to either arm.

Per block: the neutral-pose null on all 80 cases (the scored incumbent), one frozen hand-authored contact controller on all 80 cases as a decoder diagnostic (never ranked, searched or selected), then per arm every valid slot screened on 10 cases (the best slot's screen is the zero-shot result), the 24-candidate search on the 10 probe cases, the selected state on promotion (30, strict paired rule against the null) and fresh (30). Never select on fresh outcomes. At most 840 episodes per block, 6,720 in all, and 128 LLM calls.

Primary analysis: eight paired block-level differences of fresh final-incumbent native sustained success, contact_rules minus direct_joint. Zero-shot is compared with zero-shot (screen and unchanged-candidate probe) and searched with searched (searched winner on fresh, final-window hit fraction, probe-search successes, drops, failure labels). Decoder diagnostics recorded for the contact arm on screen, promotion and fresh runs: residual, bound-active fraction, request saturation, mean fingertip distance.

config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: llm_pool with 16 workers, gpt-6.1-sol, high reasoning effort, temperature 1. No edit generations, fitting, reinforcement learning or curriculum; Stage 3 only; one protocol on the box.

An interval spanning zero and +0.05 is inconclusive. Improvement requires a strictly positive lower bound; tied success is never improvement.

hand_authored.role: decoder diagnostic: never ranked, never selected, never an incumbent

result.notes: 8 blocks (seeds 4730-4737), 4 slots per arm, 24-candidate probe search, promotion against the scored neutral-pose null, fresh; 6,720 episodes in 544 Isaac processes, 75 LLM calls (34 direct_joint, 41 contact_rules), 1,163,650 tokens, 3 h 23 min wall. Primary (fresh final-incumbent success, contact_rules minus direct_joint): 0.000, t95 [0, 0]: no candidate of either arm was promoted over the null in any block. Searched (secondary): searched winner on fresh -0.0125 [-0.054, +0.029] (contact 0.008 vs direct 0.021 mean success), final-window hit fraction -0.034 [-0.128, +0.060] (0.216 vs 0.250), drops -2.6 per block [-7.6, +2.4]. Zero-shot (secondary, compared with zero-shot): screen success +0.0125 [-0.017, +0.042] (one contact candidate with a screen success in 64), screen final-window hit fraction +0.188 [+0.096, +0.281] (0.284 vs 0.096), unchanged-candidate probe success 0 vs 0. Probe-search candidates with a success: +0.875 per block [+0.34, +1.41] (11 vs 4 of 192 each), which did not carry to promotion or fresh. Validity 32/32 in both arms. Decoder diagnostics on the contact arm's searched winners (fresh): mean residual 0.108 m/s and p95 0.48 m/s against a request capped at 0.05 m/s, at least one decoder bound active on 97% of in-play steps, request saturation 0.3%, mean fingertip-origin distance to the pen surface 4.0 cm. The hand-authored contact controller (diagnostic only): 0.020 sustained success over 640 episodes, 15-34 drops of 80 per block, residual 0.101 m/s, bounds on 99% of steps. So during a rollout the decoder is nowhere near the regime the gate qualified (small pulses, pen at rest, bounds mostly inactive): once the pen moves, the surface-point velocity it follows exceeds what the bounded joints deliver, and requests are a small part of what is executed. No deviation from the protocol. Both arms read the same 182-d observation with the contact features, so this comparison isolates the output/decoder contract; whether the features themselves help direct generation is not tested here (R-092's monolithic arm used other blocks and cannot serve as a paired control).

verdicts.reasoning: By the registered rule the predicted magnitude is refuted: the primary is 0.000 with interval [0, 0] over eight blocks (upper bound below +0.05), because no candidate in either arm beat the null on promotion. The uncensored searched contrast agrees in direction and is itself inconclusive on magnitude (-0.0125 [-0.054, +0.029]). Two secondaries favour contact rules before selection pressure (zero-shot screen final-window hit fraction +0.188 [+0.096, +0.281]; probe-search candidates with a success +0.875 per block [+0.34, +1.41]) and neither survives to promotion or fresh, so they are leads, not results. The caveat both of us recorded at triage is what the diagnostics show: the decoder is not operating in its qualified regime during rollouts (residual 0.108 m/s against a 0.05 m/s request cap, a bound active on 97% of steps), and the hand-authored controller through the same decoder scores 0.02. So what is refuted is this decoder as an output contract for cold generation, not contact coordinates as such.
verdicts.next_experiment: Stop the contact-output branch under this direction. If contact coordinates are pursued, the decoder must first be qualified in the regime rollouts visit (pen moving, fingertips within a centimetre, bounds inactive), or the contact frame should be used as observation features only, tested with a paired no-feature control.

direction: Test two representation changes for cold pen-spin generation on Stage 3, independently, native sustained success primary, final test locked: (M1) LLM-generated modular policies (MODULE_SPEC + named methods + generated composition inside GeneratedPolicy, no role hints) vs monolithic, same prompt otherwise, 24-draw search for both arms; (C1) a no-LLM contact-frame decoder gate (capsule frames, fingertip Jacobians, requested vs observed local motion); (C2, only if C1 passes) LLM contact-frame velocity rules vs direct joint generation at matched budget. No BC, RL, curriculum, or gradient fitting. One protocol at a time on the box.

advisor.reasoning: The matched-budget contact-output comparison fits the direction, but its 3,400 episodes and at most 64 LLM calls must wait for a recorded C1 pass with the exact decoder hash. Reuse scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml when that prerequisite is satisfied; M1's outcome is not a scientific prerequisite. Its weakest point is resolution with only four block-level differences, especially near a native-success floor. An upper confidence bound below +0.05 for paired_success_difference versus direct_joint refutes the predicted magnitude; C1 failure supplies no C2 result.

implementer.reasoning: Defer: its decoder does not exist until R-093 passes with a recorded decoder hash, and spending 3,400 episodes and 64 calls on an unqualified decoder would confound representation with tracking failure. The design (same observations including the trusted frame features in both arms, only the output and decoder contract changed, hand-authored controller as an unranked diagnostic, offline query refused) is what I would run; four blocks is thin near the floor, so on re-triage I would ask for eight.
